data.one_liner: A customizable 3D push button with spring animations, async loading states, and accessibility.
data.what_it_does: Provides tactile 3D buttons that sink when tapped and spring back, along with BouncyPressable to add a bouncy press effect to any widget. It includes built-in handling for async loading states, double-tap prevention, and accessibility.
use_when: You want physical-feeling 3D buttons that sink and spring back when pressed
You need buttons with built-in async loading, success, and error states
You want to prevent accidental double taps on critical actions like payments
avoid_when: You strictly require standard Material Design 3 or Cupertino button styles without custom 3D effects
You are building a game that requires a dedicated game engine physics setup
strengths: Built-in protection against accidental double taps
Comprehensive accessibility support out of the box
Supports loading, success, and error states natively for async functions
weaknesses: Tied specifically to button and press interactions rather than general animation use cases
Requires using the package's custom button or pressable components
